div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MUFASA scope
African evidence-first scientific reasoning
Initial domains, countries, languages and risk levels

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Controlled taxonomy
Materials ?? organisms ?? processes ?? properties
applications ?? locations ?? methods ?? outcomes

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Data and safety policy
Allowed licences ?? consent ?? attribution
sensitive knowledge ?? medical and engineering risks

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Priority African scientific sources
Journal articles and preprints
Master's theses and doctoral dissertations
Conference papers, posters and proceedings
Government and regulator technical reports
University and research-institute publications
Open textbooks, laboratory and extension manuals
Datasets, data dictionaries and field-trial reports
Patents, standards and specifications when licensed
Author-contributed manuscripts and partner archives

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Discovery layer
AfricArXiv ?? institutional repositories ?? AJOL discovery
OpenAlex ?? Crossref ?? CORE ?? DOI and citation trails
OAI-PMH/API harvesting ?? sitemaps ?? approved crawling
direct university, institute and author partnerships

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Acquisition manifest per item
source URL ?? repository ?? access date ?? checksum
DOI/handle ?? version ?? country ?? language ?? licence
terms snapshot ?? permitted uses ?? takedown status

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Rights and ethics gate
Can this exact full text be stored,
processed and used for model training?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Metadata-only or quarantine
Do not train on uncertain, restricted,
embargoed or culturally sensitive content

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Immutable raw evidence store
Original PDF/XML/HTML/EPUB/data file
plus metadata and provenance ledger

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Detect format and quality

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Native structured path
JATS/TEI/XML/HTML/EPUB
preserve sections, equations and references

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Born-digital PDF path
GROBID/layout parser
recover title, sections, citations and coordinates

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scanned or degraded path
page images ??? OCR ??? layout recovery
language-aware spelling and symbol checks

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scientific object recovery
tables ?? units ?? equations ?? figures ?? captions
footnotes ?? bibliography ?? supplementary files

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalize without erasing meaning
Unicode ?? whitespace ?? headings ?? reading order
language ID ?? original text plus aligned translation
SI units alongside reported units

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Identity, version and integrity resolution
DOI/Handle/ORCID/ROR ?? author/affiliation/country
exact and near deduplication ?? preprint/version linking
retractions, corrections and citation resolution

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Document quality gate
Readable text? Complete sections?
Tables and units trustworthy?
Provenance still attached?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reprocess, manually repair,
or exclude from training

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Curated document store
canonical text + page/section spans
scientific objects + quality scores + provenance

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Freeze splits before augmentation
Group by paper family, DOI, thesis version, author/project
and near-duplicate cluster
Train ?? development ?? held-out test ?? challenge set

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence-grounded extraction
entity ?? process ?? variable ?? value and unit ?? condition
method ?? result ?? limitation ?? population/location
confidence + exact supporting page/section span

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scientific normalization
entity aliases ?? ontology IDs ?? unit conversion
geographic hierarchy ?? method and property vocabulary

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Claim and evidence ledger
claim ??? supporting/contradicting observations
sample size ?? study design ?? uncertainty ?? source span

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
African Scientific Knowledge Graph
material ???used_in??? application
process ???changes??? property
study ???reports_under??? conditions
claim ???supported_or_contradicted_by??? evidence

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Scientific review gate
Schema valid? Numbers and units match?
Claim supported? Conflicts preserved?
High-risk content expert-reviewed?

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Versioned scientific corpus
structured records + graph + evidence bundles
with confidence, lineage and review status

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional continued-pretraining corpus
licensed, cleaned scientific text
balanced by domain, country, language and document type
quality-weighted; boilerplate and references controlled

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reasoning task blueprint
explain ?? compare studies ?? calculate ?? diagnose disagreement
weigh evidence ?? identify limitations ?? transfer cautiously
recommend local alternatives ?? propose testable experiments
abstain when evidence is insufficient

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence bundles
single-paper and multi-paper packets
claims + tables + conditions + conflicting findings
Example: rice-husk ash at 5/10/15% across humid climates

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Teacher generation with strict schema
question + evidence-grounded solution + concise rationale
final answer + citations + uncertainty + failure conditions
Generate diverse candidates; never invent missing evidence

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Automatic validators
JSON/schema ?? citation/span entailment ?? number/unit checks
answerability ?? contradiction ?? duplication ?? PII/toxicity
teacher agreement and unsupported-claim detection

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Human review and active sampling
African domain experts adjudicate high-risk, novel,
low-confidence and model-disagreement examples

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SFT dataset: conversational JSONL
system + user/evidence context + assistant answer
Keep provenance in metadata; train on verified content
Use concise, inspectable rationales???not gratuitous hidden CoT

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Frozen MUFASA benchmark
no teacher-generated siblings from training papers
knowledge ?? calculations ?? synthesis ?? citation grounding
local relevance ?? calibration ?? safety ?? abstention

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Base checkpoint selection
Start candidate: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507
verify licence, tokenizer, context, hardware and baseline scores
retain untouched base checkpoint for comparison

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Baseline evaluation
base model on frozen MUFASA benchmark
record accuracy, grounding, calibration, latency and memory

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Does baseline lack domain language
and African scientific knowledge?

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Optional domain continued pretraining
next-token learning on CPT corpus
BF16 preferred; conservative LR + replay/general data
monitor general-capability forgetting

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reasoning SFT
full fine-tune or LoRA in BF16
loss on assistant response; curriculum from single evidence
to multi-study synthesis; checkpoint and seed tracking

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SFT release gate
Improves held-out African science?
Citations/numbers faithful?
General reasoning and safety retained?

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approved SFT checkpoint
reproducible config + adapter/full weights
tokenizer + data manifest + model card draft

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Preference prompts
held out from SFT examples but from training split sources
target known failures: overclaiming, bad citations, weak local fit,
unit errors, ignored contradictions and unsafe advice

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate generation from SFT checkpoint
sample 4???8 materially different answers per prompt
vary reasoning quality???not merely tone or length

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pairwise scientific rubric
1 Evidence fidelity ?? 2 scientific correctness
3 calculation/unit accuracy ?? 4 African-context relevance
5 uncertainty/limitations ?? 6 citation quality
7 clarity, safety and appropriate abstention

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hard preference pairs
prompt + chosen + rejected
Chosen is demonstrably better; rejected remains plausible
store scores, judge rationale, evidence IDs and annotator

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Expert adjudication
review close calls, high-risk domains and judge disagreement
remove style/verbosity bias and unverifiable preferences

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DPO training
initialize policy from approved SFT checkpoint
train policy against a frozen reference or adapter equivalent
small LR; tune beta; monitor KL, margins and validation loss

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Final model gate
blind human comparison: Base vs SFT vs DPO
frozen benchmark + adversarial unsupported-premise tests
accept only if preference gains do not damage facts/grounding

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approved MUFASA DPO checkpoint
BF16 master artifact retained
complete lineage, evaluations and limitations
